filter_tests: filter tests to run based on changed files in a pull request compared to the base branch
affects_c_cpp: check if a pull request changes any C or C++ source files in the repository
get_changed_files: get a list of changed file names between the current branch and a target merge branch
can_skip_tests: determine if tests can be skipped by checking if changed files match any trigger regex patterns
remove_irrelevant_tests: remove tests from a list by filtering out those whose platform or language labels are skippable
